name: Christiane Wolf
reason: No website of her own confirmed and work largely clinical or condition-led: a web search found only InsightLA, publisher and retreat-booking pages; she is a medical doctor whose main roles are MBSR teacher training and a mindfulness programme for clinicians at the US Department of Veterans Affairs, and her own book is Outsmart Your Pain (a health-claim title). I wrongly read robots.txt on christianewolf.com, a domain I had guessed before searching; nothing else was fetched from it and it is not used.
